# HariLeaf

> HariLeaf is a farm in Wada, Palghar district, Maharashtra, India, that grows heritage rice, turmeric and seasonal fruit and sells them direct at harileaf.org. Rice is grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilisers, hand-harvested, sun-dried and milled in a single pass to remove only the husk, so the bran and germ stay on the grain. Turmeric is PGS-India Organic certified, boiled, sun-cured and slowly stone-ground at low temperature so more of its aromatic oils stay in the powder; curcumin is lab-tested. Kesar mangoes are ripened on hay at the farm, without calcium carbide. Every pack carries a batch code and packed-on date, and lab reports are published on product pages. The shop delivers across India (fresh mangoes within Mumbai MMR only); buyers outside India can register interest.

## Products

- [Heritage rice](https://harileaf.org/rice/): Karjat 3, Kolam rice from Wada, and red rice — unpolished, single-pass milled
- [Turmeric and spices](https://harileaf.org/spices/): stone-ground turmeric powder and whole dried turmeric fingers
- [Fresh produce](https://harileaf.org/produce/): hay-ripened Kesar mangoes in season, and other farm produce
- [Shop](https://harileaf.org/shop/): all products with prices, pack sizes and availability

## How it is made

- [Our process](https://harileaf.org/our-process/): how HariLeaf grows, mills and grinds
- [Guides](https://harileaf.org/learn/): milling, grinding, curing and ripening explained
- [Recipes](https://harileaf.org/recipes/): everyday recipes with HariLeaf rice and spices
